paras: Sceloporus taeniocnemis, also known commonly as the Guatemalan emerald spiny lizard and la chachapaja in Spanish, is a species of lizard in the family Phrynosomatidae. The species is native to Guatemala and adjacent southeastern Mexico. There are two recognized subspecies.
S. taeniocnemis is found in central Guatemala and in the Mexican state of Chiapas.
The preferred natural habitat of S. taeniocnemis is forest, at altitudes of 1,200–2,500 m (3,900–8,200 ft).
The following two subspecies are recognized as being valid, including the nominotypical subspecies.
The subspecific name, hartwegi, is in honor of American herpetologist Norman Edouard Hartweg.
